ee358795fc20eeb9cfc2c388318bf3a0d1e13f09.sourceText: 位置与点坐标沿用上游的 m，姿态使用无量纲四元数，时间戳由秒和纳秒字段表达；本节点不缩放单位、不再次降采样，也不做两种输入的时间同步。里程计沿用输入位姿时间戳，正常点云转换沿用输入点云时间戳；后者已对照容器安装的 `pcl_ros 2.4.5` [对应实现](https://github.com/ros-perception/perception_pcl/blob/2.4.5/pcl_ros/src/transforms.cpp#L91)核对。
ee358795fc20eeb9cfc2c388318bf3a0d1e13f09.translatedText: Position and point coordinates follow the upstream m, orientation uses a dimensionless quaternion, and timestamps are expressed by seconds and nanoseconds fields; this node does not scale units, does not downsample again, and does not perform time synchronization between the two inputs\. Odometry follows the input pose timestamp, and normal point cloud conversion follows the input point cloud timestamp; the latter has been checked against the container\-installed `pcl_ros 2.4.5` [corresponding implementation](https://github.com/ros-perception/perception_pcl/blob/2.4.5/pcl_ros/src/transforms.cpp#L91)\.
